items.title: Grace Fisk and Khiara Keating named in latest England squad
items.author: By Sam Williams
items.excerpt: Grace Fisk and Khiara Keating have been called up to the latest England squad. The Liverpool FC Women duo are part of the Lionesses’ group for their upcoming two-legged World Cup qualification play-off tie against Ukraine. England and Ukraine will first meet in Spain on Tuesday December 1, with the return leg at Wembley on Saturday December 5. The winners of the tie will qualify for the 2027 World Cup finals in Brazil.
